user.title: Water Softener Salt Tracker Configuration
user.description: Configure tracking parameters based on your water meter and softener specifications.

data_description.water_meter_sensor: A cumulative water meter in litres that measures all the water going through the softener.
data_description.consumption_rate: Grams of salt used per litre of water. See the README for typical values, or calibrate from a full refill.
data_description.manufacturer: Shown on the device page, for example Harvey.
data_description.model: Shown on the device page, for example Dual Flo H20/25.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure water softener
reconfigure.description: If you switch to a different water meter, the water used since your last refill is carried over, so your salt level stays the same. If the current meter has no reading, tracking restarts from the new meter's reading.

error.meter_unavailable: This water meter has no reading right now. Try again once it is available.

meter_below_baseline.title: Water meter reading is below the salt tracker baseline
meter_below_baseline.description:
The water meter `{entity_id}` used by **{name}** reads {reading}, which is lower than the reading of {baseline} stored at the last salt refill. The meter has probably been reset or replaced, so salt usage cannot be tracked correctly.

Press the **Reset Salt Level** button to start tracking again from the current meter reading.
